verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's SRE Agent is documented to diagnose and troubleshoot incidents autonomously. It pulls telemetry from connectors such as Sentry logs and analyzes code in GitHub, and pricing copy advertises automated incident investigation. Missing for 10: documented AI correlation of recent change events with the incident, similar-past-incident matching, explicit documentation that investigation starts proactively on trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: help rapidly diagnose, troubleshoot, and remediate issues
SRE Agent handles incidents and fixes. You step in when it matters.
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by retrieving log data from Sentry
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by analyzing code within GitHub
automated incident detection, investigation and remediation by blended teams of agents + humans
